ja: イ カ ロ ス ・ ゼ ロ 復 活 ！ ！
『ダンボール戦機Ｗ』より、山野バンのＬＢＸイカロス・ゼロが登場！
当時のランナー仕様をそのままに復活！

本体の色分けを成形色とシールで再現。
ランナーにはパーツが探しやすいパーツアイコン付き！
ディスプレイベースが付属！

●　幅広い可動範囲でカッコよくポージングさせる事が可能！

en: Icarus Zero is back! !
From "Danball Senki W" comes Yamano Ban's LBX Icarus Zero!
Restored with the original Runner specifications intact!
● 1/1 LBX Icarus Zero is back!
The color coding of the main body is reproduced with molding colors and seals.
Runner has parts icons that make it easy to find parts!
Display base included!
● "Zero Lance" and "Zero Sealdo" are included!
● It is possible to make cool poses with a wide range of motion!
● Transforms from normal state to Weapon form! Exhibition is possible with a display base!
In conjunction with LBX Icarus Force (sold separately),
Reproducing Icarus Force's special function "00 (Double Zero) Sword"!
Attached weapons: Zero Lance / Zero Seal
Accessories: Display base
1/1 Scale Assembly type plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
